comparison.objective: Fold a camp stool shut and lay it flat while keeping grippers out of the pinch zone; candidate finishes four HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Stool task tests symmetric bimanual folding, articulated-object control, tipping, and pinch avoidance; candidate tests coaxial mandrel stabilization, impact regulation, withdrawal, and tiny-part recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Stool must close, lie flat, avoid gripper intrusion into the marked pinch point, and end with arms reset; candidate requires four damage-free fractures and four contained tangs.
comparison.reason: Articulated folding with pinch safety does not duplicate impact-based insert finishing.
